title: Amelia | Black Playsuit with Flattering V-Neckline and Delicate Trim
bodyHtml:
Slip into effortless elegance with this romantic black playsuit that flatters from day to evening. The deep V-neckline draws the eye upward, whilst the defined waist skims your silhouette beautifully. Soft, fluid fabric drapes gracefully without clinging, creating movement that feels as good as it looks—perfect for warm summer nights or cooler evening outings.

Why you'll love it

  • V-neckline designed to flatter and frame your shoulders with understated glamour
  • Defined waist that creates a beautiful silhouette and elongates your frame
  • Soft, breathable fabric that moves with you all night without restricting
  • Delicate detailing around the neckline adds a feminine, polished touch
  • Waist sits comfortably on your natural curves, giving you freedom to move
  • Effortlessly takes you from day plans to evening drinks and weekend celebrations
  • Genuinely hard to find—a versatile piece with real style and character
